report:
Reviewed the complete lookup.dependencies claim, all five implementation associations across resolver/ribs/symbol files and the sole TODO test. Captured the resolution design and accepted interface-dependency RFD. Source inspection only; no test execution or source changes.

The claim requires dependencies to follow actually searched lexical/module scopes and keyed external membership, provider identity discovery before selected signatures, and no checked-body read. ribs.rs lookup scans lexical scopes/entries in reverse precedence order and returns the first name/namespace match without requesting semantic products. Resolver::resolve_path and resolve_name_from_scope consult ribs first where applicable, then follow module paths/import edges and prelude rules. Local module lookup scans that searched module's expanded items and resolves matching named imports or relevant glob edges. This is not recursive enumeration of every module in the crate.

The symbol.rs named_children association is a tracked lookup keyed by external owner, name and namespace; it obtains the owner's raw membership and filters the metadata edge before returning canonical symbol identities. ModSymbol::expanded_module_items dispatches to the selected local or external owner. The separate trait_children association enumerates only trait identities from external membership, avoiding interpretation of unrelated unsupported child kinds. Resolver traits_in_method_scope uses these identities together with current-module/import/prelude membership and completeness information; it does not request function signatures or bodies during provider enumeration. Raw membership remains module-keyed even when the lowered named lookup adds name/namespace, so this report does not invent a finer provider-input granularity than implemented. The associated lookup path contains no checked-body query.

The sole resolution_lookup_dependencies test is TODO with no assertions. It requires cold/warm exact-scope/external-key traces excluding unsearched modules, unrelated associated signatures and all checked bodies, plus reuse after unrelated edits. Completing that persistent trace matrix, including the downstream selected-signature boundary, is prerequisite to full verification. Source-level identity enumeration and lack of obvious body calls do not establish every transitive or incremental dependency case. The RFD's allowance for coarse input reexecution/backdating is retained without weakening the semantic boundary. All five implementation entries and all claim aspects are accounted for, with verification honestly deferred; no concrete additional defect was identified and no edits are requested.
